title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can’t believe you guys got in the playoff
I can't imagine how frustrating it must be to be an Auburn, Ohio State, or USC fan because of it
Don’t get me wrong I think you guys are better than Ohio State, maybe by far, just thought their resume stood out as better

You really could argue it any way you want, there's legitimate reasoning on pretty much any side of the argument OSU better wins, resume overall OSU worse loss Bama better loss "Eye test" (I thought OSU looked unimpressive v Wisky, although you can argue Bama was worse v Auburn) Etc etc All water under bridge now and I'm looking forward to the games. Clemson D-line scares me though. That's basically why Auburn beat us.
Where did you go to school? I don't think I've ever asked you that

It's been good, little different on the scouting side because we have a bunch of fall-ball shit to cover, so "off-season" really starts right around now. Still doing some meetings with players and stuff but all the actual game/on field stuff is over. Did a little fishing a couple weeks ago and had a good thanksgiving with family.

It’s going good. Thanksgiving was OK, my long distance relationship hit a rough patch but we’re working through it. Tigers haven’t done much, which is good. Should be a relatively uneventful off-season, knock on wood. Winter meetings coming up. Where at in Florida are you?

Long distance deal is tough.  Been there before. Gotta imagine if we move someone it will be next week, but you never know. Can't imagine any big signing, just the low level stuff...but frankly I have less insight in to that side of the org than probably you do. I'm in St Petersburg, wasn't planning on going to the meetings...at least I hope they don't ask me to at the last second. I'm planning on heading to the Keys with my wife for a few days next week...mini vacation

It’s really tough, the distance. Hope the market can work in Al’s favor for Kinsler. He is a heck of a player. Taking off from DC (relationship maintenance weekend), good chat, have fun and safe travels
Safe travels to you my man. Hope it all works out for ya. Talk at ya soon
